name: submission-segment-survival
description: The submission-scoped log segment (design §6.2) holds submission-accepted/-rejected/-closed events — facts that exist BEFORE or WITHOUT any Attempt. A rejected Submission must stay durable and distinguishable from a never-seen one after restart, so `observe`/`watch` have a defined substrate even when no Attempt was ever engaged.

details.detail: attempts: {maxTotal:2} outside the 1..1 the local backend supports

expected.note: a Submission URI with no submission-scoped segment entry at all is 'never seen' (unknown); one with a submission-rejected entry is durably 'rejected' — these two must never be confused after a restart rebuilds only from durable records
